notes.title: 📢 Patch Notes – June 29
notes.content:
🛠️ Changelog:
⚡ Optimization
✅ Improved overall game optimization — reduced GPU load for smoother performance, especially on lower-end systems.

🏆 Steam Achievements
✅ Added Steam Achievements — start collecting and show off your progress!

🌎 Localization
✅ Improved language translations — more accurate and polished text across all supported languages.

🤝 Multiplayer Teaser
🚧 Multiplayer mode is under active development — stay tuned for future updates on cooperative horror survival!

notes.title: 📢 Patch Notes – June 28
notes.content:
🛠️ Changelog:

🔊 Audio Updates
✅ Added new ambient sound paths – enhanced atmosphere and immersion from the start.

🕹️ Intro Content
✅ Expanded early gameplay content – more depth and story right from the beginning.

💡 Lighting
✅ Improved lighting quality – environments are now clearer and more visually dynamic.

🔦 Flashlight
✅ Upgraded flashlight functionality – smoother controls and more reliable illumination.

🚪 Maze Doors
✅ Fixed door behavior in the maze – no more glitches or unintended blockages.

🎥 Observation Towers
✅ Fixed observation towers – now function properly and respond as expected.

📦 Other Improvements
✅ General stability and polish updates for an even better experience.

notes.title: 📢 Patch Notes – June 27
notes.content:
[p]🛠️ Changelog:

🎥 Surveillance System[/p][p]✅ Fixed camera towers in the maze – now they work properly and looking at them helps avoid the monster’s jumpscare.

💾 Save System
✅ Fixed artifact save/load – your progress with the artifact is now correctly preserved.

🔒 Level Progression
✅ Locked level 2 – now accessible only after obtaining the artifact, ensuring a smoother progression flow.

📝 Tutorial Fixes
✅ Applied several fixes to the tutorial for a clearer and smoother learning experience.

📦 Other Improvements
✅ General stability and polish updates for a better overall experience[/p]

notes.title: 📢 Patch Notes – June 26
notes.content:
[p]🛠️ Changelog:

🛒 Save System
✅ Fixed item saving – your inventory and purchases are now correctly preserved.

🕹️ Lobby
✅ Fixed several issues in the lobby to improve stability and matchmaking experience.[/p][p]
⛏️ Mining[/p][p]✅ Fixed bug with mining cubes – now digging works smoothly without glitches.[/p][p]
⚙️ Performance

📦 Other Improvements
✅ General stability and polish updates for a better overall experience.[/p]

notes.title: 📢 Patch Notes – June 25
notes.content:
🛠️ Changelog:

🎙️ Cassette System
✅ Added full translation support for VHS tapes.
✅ Filled in missing translations in UI and interactions.

🔊 Audio & Atmosphere
✅ Implemented smooth fade-in/fade-out transitions for audio effects.
✅ Background music now fades out before scene transitions and fades back in based on user settings.

🎮 Gameplay & UI
✅ Added UI spawner indicator
✅ Progress saving now works properly in the shop – your purchases and state are no longer lost. 🔐

📦 Other Improvements
✅ General stability and UX improvements.
✅ Lots of small polish touches that make a big difference.

notes.title: 📢 Patch Notes – June 24
notes.content:
🛠️ Changelog:
[list]
 ✅ Fixed an issue in the starting tutorial that could prevent players from progressing.
 ✅ Improved onboarding flow for new users to make early gameplay more intuitive.
 ✅ Fixed item dropping bug in the lobby – items should no longer disappear or cause glitches.
 ✅ Tutorial fixes – Flashlight & Green Sticks – now functioning correctly without skipping steps.
 ✅ Fixed NPC dialogue behavior – NPCs now correctly hide dialogues when the player leaves the area.
 🔄 General UI and stability improvements for a smoother experience.
[/list]

Thanks for playing and stay tuned for more updates!
